About the Scholarship

ReSound is the Erasmus Mundus master in sound design for media arts, preparing sound artists and designers across a European consortium led from Lisbon. The application window for the September 2027 intake opened on 19 October 2026 and closes on 12 January 2027.

OpportunityReSound – European Sound Masters (Erasmus Mundus)
HostReSound Consortium
LocationLisbon (multi-country mobility), Portugal
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
StipendErasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students:
Application Deadline12 January 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

ReSound is the Erasmus Mundus master in sound design for media arts, preparing sound artists and designers across a European consortium led from Lisbon. The application window for the September 2027 intake opened on 19 October 2026 and closes on 12 January 2027.

Programme Highlights

  • Dedicated sound-design master within the Erasmus Mundus portfolio
  • January 12, 2027 deadline for the September 2027 intake
  • Mobility across European universities with production facilities
  • Graduates work in film, games, installation art and immersive media

Who Should Apply

Applicants from sound design, music, film, media arts and related creative-technology backgrounds; a portfolio is typically central to the selection file.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus a monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the ReSound website before 12 January 2027 and prepare the portfolio according to the call instructions. Key deadline information: 12 January 2027; applications opened 19 October 2026 for the September 2027 intake.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About ReSound Consortium

The ReSound consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in sound design for media arts with European universities specialised in cinema, music and digital media.

Official website: https://resound-ma.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 12 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
